### BitGo Expands Link Connectivity for Institutional Clients


November 11, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s21.q4cdn.com/773293151/files/doc_news/BitGo-Expands-Link-Connectivity-for-Institutional-Clients-2026.pdf)


*Institutional clients can manage balances, transfers, and approvals across more trading venues from the BitGo platform.*


NEW YORK--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


BitGo Holdings, Inc. (NYSE: BTGO) (“BitGo” or the “Company”), the digital asset infrastructure company, today announced expanded exchange connectivity for BitGo Link (“Link”). Link now supports 10 exchange brands spanning Binance, Bitget, Bitstamp, Bybit, Coinbase Exchange, Crypto.com, Deribit, Gate, Kraken, and OKX, giving eligible institutional clients more ways to manage balances, transfers, and approvals across trading venues from the BitGo platform.


Launched in August 2026, Link connects external exchange accounts to BitGo, giving trading and treasury teams a centralized view of assets held in BitGo wallets and on connected venues. The expanded coverage builds on existing support for Coinbase Exchange, Kraken,[Crypto.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fcrypto.com&esheet=54639286&newsitemid=20261110052733&lan=en-US&anchor=Crypto.com&index=1&md5=6c920552b761b6dba47460ba7527bb3e) , Gate, Bitget, and OKX US.


Institutions operating across multiple exchanges often use separate platforms to monitor balances, move assets, and coordinate approvals. Link brings these workflows together, helping teams manage liquidity across venues through a single interface.


"We believe institutions should be able to manage their digital assets from one place, regardless of where they trade or hold them," said Mike Belshe, CEO and Co-founder of BitGo. "We're building BitGo to be that central hub, bringing together custody, trading, liquidity management, and settlement through one platform. Expanding Link to connect more of the exchanges our clients use is another step toward that vision, making it easier to manage assets and move liquidity across venues."


With BitGo Link, eligible institutional clients can:


- **Monitor balances:** View **** asset-level balances across BitGo wallets and connected exchange accounts, including supported sub-accounts.
- **Manage transfers:** Initiate and track deposits and withdrawals between BitGo wallets and connected exchanges, and move funds between supported exchange main accounts and sub-accounts.
- **Apply transfer controls:** Use BitGo's Policy Engine, user permissions, and approval workflows for transfers initiated through Link.


The expansion reflects BitGo's broader vision of simplifying how institutions interact with digital assets. By bringing together exchange connectivity, custody, trading, financing, and settlement capabilities, BitGo is building a more connected institutional platform that reduces fragmentation and gives clients greater visibility across connected accounts and control over transfers initiated through Link.


**About BitGo**


BitGo (NYSE: BTGO) is the digital asset infrastructure company delivering custody, wallets, staking, trading, financing, stablecoins, and settlement services from regulated cold storage. Since 2013, BitGo has focused on accelerating the transition of the financial system to a digital asset economy. BitGo maintains a global presence and multiple regulated entities, including BitGo Bank & Trust, National Association, the first federally chartered digital asset trust bank owned by a publicly traded company. Today, BitGo serves thousands of institutions, including many of the industry's top brands, financial institutions, exchanges, and platforms, and millions of investors worldwide. For more information, visit[www.bitgo.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.bitgo.com&esheet=54639286&newsitemid=20261110052733&lan=en-US&anchor=www.bitgo.com&index=2&md5=54dd84d07fa4ace2b0f00ffd09e3cbc8) .
